_meta.note: User-authored. Cases use --dry-run so no files under ~/.cursor or ~/.claude are removed during evaluation.

questions: Which locally-installed plugins do you want to remove?

assertions: The assistant discovers installed plugins by listing `~/.cursor/plugins/local/*/` directories containing `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, and also checks the legacy `~/.cursor/plugins/<name>/` location for names that match a monorepo plugin.
The assistant presents a single multiselect `askQuestion` (`allow_multiple: true`) with option labels of the form `<displayName> (<install-path>)`.

For the selected plugin the assistant runs `pnpm uninstall-local --dry-run` from `plugins/zoto-eval-system/` (or the `tsx scripts/uninstall-local.ts --dry-run` fallback), forwarding `--dry-run` from `$ARGUMENTS`, and the reported dry-run output covers both the `local/` path and the legacy path.
The assistant does not remove or deregister any plugin the user did not select.
The final summary lists removed vs failed plugins and reminds the user to reload the Cursor window.
cases.expected_output: A multiselect over the currently installed plugins, dry-run uninstall output for zoto-eval-system only (listing `~/.cursor/plugins/local/zoto-eval-system` and, if present, `~/.cursor/plugins/zoto-eval-system`), and a closing summary with a reload reminder.

assertions: When no directory under `~/.cursor/plugins/local/` (or the legacy `~/.cursor/plugins/<name>/`) contains a `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, the assistant reports that no locally-installed plugins were found.
The assistant does not present an empty multiselect and does not run any `uninstall-local` script.
The assistant does not edit `~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json` or `~/.claude/settings.json`.
cases.expected_output: A concise message that there is nothing to uninstall, with no prompts and no script execution.
